title: Founding act body
description: Founding a market institution (register row DK397; spec-delta S505; docs/institutions/charter.md, the decision of IS1). One record type with an act. propose: a person or an agent with a passport proposes an institution at did:web:asp.local:market:<name> and locks the entry stake (500 credits, a beta default) in the founding-stake account. review: a quorum of a drawn panel (none of whom is the founder, its sponsor or the Registrar) approves or rejects; a rejection returns the stake whole, an approval puts the institution on probation for 90 days, then active, for a term of a year. renew: the founder renews in the last 60 days of a term, or up to 30 days after it; later the institution has lapsed. merge: both founders sign a closing of the first institution with the second as successor; the first founder's stake returns whole. The charter of a market institution is an institution_charter record (kind market) signed by the founder. A founding gives no Treasury budget, standing or say in the society's rules. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.
